key_insight: This review connects reinforcement learning with PDE-constrained optimization to organize approaches for feedback control of complex distributed systems.
engineering_relevance: RL offers a route to real-time PDE control, but practical deployment depends on sample efficiency, scalability, and generalization across operating conditions.
method: Unify perspectives from RL and PDE-constrained optimization.
Survey model-free, model-based, and multi-agent control approaches.
Illustrate performance and pitfalls through chaotic-system stabilization and flow control.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes two demonstrative control examples and discusses benchmarking, but reports no quantitative results.
watch_item: Reliability under parametric variations remains a concern before deploying learned controllers in practice.
paper_title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
